players.product: mass flow controllers and in-situ process monitors for semiconductor tools

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 (January - December 2025) consolidated results: net sales JPY 333,081 million (+5.0% year on year), operating income JPY 53,040 million (+9.7%), ordinary income JPY 54,226 million (+8.1%), net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 37,090 million (+10.4%). Management states sales grew mainly in Energy & Environment and Advanced Materials & Semiconductor; ROE was 11.2%. From FY2025 the reportable segments changed from Automotive / Environmental & Process / Medical / Semiconductor / Scientific to three fields: Energy & Environment, Bio & Healthcare, and Advanced Materials & Semiconductor.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 net sales JPY 333,081 million (+5.0%); operating income JPY 53,040 million (+9.7%)

quarterly_data.signal: Advanced Materials & Semiconductor field (mass flow controllers, chemical concentration monitors, semiconductor particle inspection systems, residual gas analyzers and other analyzers), FY2025: net sales JPY 156,500 million (+4.5%) and operating income JPY 44,517 million (-1.0%). Management states demand related to advanced semiconductors such as for generative AI drove higher sales to semiconductor equipment manufacturers, mainly in Asia, while operating income declined because the company accelerated new-product development and technology development investment.
quarterly_data.figure: segment sales JPY 156,500 million (+4.5%); operating income JPY 44,517 million (-1.0%)

quarterly_data.signal: Other fields, FY2025: Energy & Environment net sales JPY 134,407 million (+5.5%), operating income JPY 9,417 million (+120.9%); management states automotive sales rose as demand for combustion measurement for hybrid vehicle development increased while the EV shift slowed, mainly in Europe and the Americas. Bio & Healthcare net sales JPY 42,173 million (+5.0%), operating loss JPY 894 million (prior year loss JPY 890 million), citing tougher competition and continued life-science investment.
quarterly_data.figure: Energy & Environment JPY 134,407 million; Bio & Healthcare JPY 42,173 million

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 orders received and order backlog by segment: Advanced Materials & Semiconductor orders JPY 151,151 million (+10.4%), backlog JPY 50,830 million (-9.5%); Energy & Environment orders JPY 125,046 million (-10.1%), backlog JPY 91,463 million (-9.3%); Bio & Healthcare orders JPY 42,300 million (+1.0%), backlog JPY 11,107 million (+1.2%). Total orders JPY 318,498 million (+0.2%); total year-end backlog JPY 153,401 million (-8.7%).
quarterly_data.figure: total orders JPY 318,498 million (+0.2%); backlog JPY 153,401 million (-8.7%)

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 production (at selling prices) by segment: Advanced Materials & Semiconductor JPY 148,925 million (+6.2%), Energy & Environment JPY 134,174 million (-0.6%), Bio & Healthcare JPY 42,248 million (+6.2%); total JPY 325,348 million (+3.3%).

FY2025 net sales by customer location: Asia excluding China JPY 79,486 million, Japan JPY 76,650 million, Europe JPY 72,055 million, China JPY 59,513 million, United States JPY 37,580 million, other JPY 7,794 million; total JPY 333,081 million. The company reports no single customer accounting for 10% or more of consolidated net sales.
quarterly_data.figure: China JPY 59,513 million; Asia excl. China JPY 79,486 million

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 capital expenditure (including intangibles) totaled JPY 27,451 million, mainly construction of the group's Global Headquarters (tentative name); by segment Advanced Materials & Semiconductor JPY 12,155 million, Energy & Environment JPY 12,074 million, Bio & Healthcare JPY 3,221 million.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 capex JPY 27,451 million (Advanced Materials & Semiconductor JPY 12,155 million)

quarterly_data.signal: Planned new facility: HORIBA STEC's Kyoto Fukuchiyama Plant (tentative name; Fukuchiyama, Kyoto), production facilities for the Advanced Materials & Semiconductor segment; total planned investment JPY 17,000 million, of which JPY 9,155 million already paid; started July 2024, completion scheduled for April 2026; production capacity to increase 200% after completion.

Planned new facility: Horiba Global Headquarters (tentative name; Minami-ku, Kyoto), used by all segments; total planned investment JPY 37,000 million, of which JPY 9,957 million already paid; started December 2025, completion scheduled for January 2028.

FY2025 group R&D expenses JPY 24,688 million, of which Advanced Materials & Semiconductor JPY 11,022 million. In that field the company developed and launched a pressure controller mounted in semiconductor manufacturing equipment that controls wafer backside pressure, a vaporizer for liquid materials used mainly in deposition processes, and a vacuum gauge for high-temperature processes; it is integrating the products and technology of the acquired EtaMax into its fully automatic wafer inspection systems, and is investing to expand the Kyoto Fukuchiyama Technology Center. For advanced materials it launched a particle size and shape analyzer (semiconductors, secondary batteries, pharmaceuticals) and focused on developing a metal film thickness measurement system for film-coating processes of electronic components and a fine-particle size distribution monitor.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 R&D JPY 24,688 million (Advanced Materials & Semiconductor JPY 11,022 million)

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 R&D in the other fields: Energy & Environment JPY 9,430 million (launched a portable emission measurement system with the company's IRLAM infrared analysis technology, a catalyst-coating monitor for fuel cells and water electrolyzers, a portable turbidity meter and an ammonia / nitrate nitrogen meter); Bio & Healthcare JPY 4,235 million (launched a centrifugal blood analyzer POCT device in Japan, plans to launch a new automated hematology analyzer developed in Europe in 2026, and is co-developing with Fujifilm a device that introduces genes into cells for gene-therapy drug manufacturing).
quarterly_data.figure: Energy & Environment R&D JPY 9,430 million; Bio & Healthcare R&D JPY 4,235 million

quarterly_data.signal: Company targets under the MLMAP2028 mid-to-long-term plan (set February 2024, target year 2028): consolidated net sales JPY 450 billion, operating income JPY 80 billion, ROE of 12% or more. Field targets for 2028: Advanced Materials & Semiconductor net sales JPY 235 billion, operating income JPY 58.5 billion (25% margin); Energy & Environment JPY 158 billion / JPY 15.8 billion (10%); Bio & Healthcare JPY 57 billion / JPY 5.7 billion (10%). The company states the plan is under review and a revision is scheduled to be published in August 2026.
